scope: SHORING / ค้ำยัน; licensed engineer must map applicable clauses to actual design and resistance basis

note: Do not conclude EC factors 1.1 and 1.5 automatically satisfy these ratios; do not blindly apply another factor to an already reduced permissible rating either. Require explicit resistance/workload mapping. Physical quantity conversion kgf/cm2->MPa uses 0.0980665, not a design factor.
